messages.subject: Trouble installing natverse
parts:
I'm trying to install natverse today, and I'm getting the following error:

Running `R CMD build`...
* checking for file 'C:\Users\arm446\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp6HfAyi\remotes377c3167745a\natverse-natverse-246a410/DESCRIPTION' ... OK
* preparing 'natverse':
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... ERROR
Malformed Authors@R field:
  <text>:13:24: unexpected symbol
12:       person(given = "Alexander”,
13:              family = "Bates
                           ^

See section 'The DESCRIPTION file' in the 'Writing R Extensions'
manual.
STDOUT:
* checking for file 'C:\Users\arm446\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp6HfAyi\remotes377c3167745a\natverse-natverse-246a410/DESCRIPTION' ... OK
* preparing 'natverse':
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... ERROR
Malformed Authors@R field:
  <text>:13:24: unexpected symbol
12:       person(given = "Alexander”,
13:              family = "Bates
                           ^

See section 'The DESCRIPTION file' in the 'Writing R Extensions'
manual.
STDERR:

Error: Failed to install 'natverse' from GitHub:
  Failed to `R CMD build` package, try `build = FALSE`.

I see that there is a weird quotation mark character after the name Alexander, which may be causing the problem.

Thanks for any help you can provide,
Andrew
